static_traits.name: An Cheng
static_traits.family_status: living with spouse, has two daughters; Tense family relationships due to Self-doubt about cooking
static_traits.social_status: has several good friends, but has not yet discussed Self-doubt feelings with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history; never received psychotherapy in the past; no similar psychological problems before
static_traits.language_features: clear expression, rather negative tone, tense and uneasy on site, acceptable cooperation but lacking confidence in change, tending toward Self-denial and avoiding discussing feelings with others

basic_info.main_problem: I believe I will never become a great Chef, though I love cooking, and this thought causes Self-doubt and Self-denial.
basic_info.core_demands: these Self-doubt feelings are affecting my confidence and passion for cooking, and affecting my daily life, so I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: several years ago, after Receiving negative feedback following one cooking session, initially triggering moderate stress; afterward confidence in cooking dropped significantly, frequent Self-doubt began and Cooking for others was avoided. Although feeling satisfied and confident about one's work many times before the negative feedback, these positive experiences were 'overshadowed' after the bad review, seen by the client as 'not counting', gradually forming the belief 'I will never become a great Chef' and affecting Family relationships, daily mood and motivation.

core_beliefs: I will never become a great Chef

special_situations.event: Receiving negative feedback on a dish a few years ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if my dishes are negatively reviewed, it provesI am not good enough, and I can never become a great chef
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: avoiding Cooking for others, repeated Self-doubt, trying to compensate by watching tutorials and practicing new recipes but still not daring to show
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I did terribly,I will not succeed

special_situations.event: Whenever needing to cook for others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if cooking for others, less-than-perfect means failure and will disappoint them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: avoiding Cooking for others, to reduce chances of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: they may not like my dishes,I will disappoint them

special_situations.event: When thinking about pursuing a cooking career or entering a professional kitchen
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I cannot reach professional kitchens' high standards, it means I am not suited for this path
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Gives up career direction, reduces attempts, and avoids discussing with friends to avoid exposing vulnerability
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I definitely cannot make it in professional kitchens, this dream is slipping away

special_situations.event: when the wife and daughters express liking his cooking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: positive feedback does not represent true ability, past good performance does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negating positive experiences, not sharing true feelings with family and friends

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and liked through cooking, and to be seen as a capable person in family and profession
core_conflict.fear: fear of being criticized and negated, fear of disappointing family, fear of failing in professional kitchens
defense_goal: maintaining a sense of safety by avoiding others' judgment (not Cooking for others)
negating positive feedback to avoid possible failure after raised expectations

object_relations.self_representation: a not-good-enough family provider/family Chef, prone to be One who disappoints the family
object_relations.object_representation: Family members I have let down or who may be disappointed in me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: when the counselor invites him to examine and challenge the belief 'I will never become a great Chef', or suggests behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: the client tends to believe change will not happen and trying is futile (transferentially bringing failure Anticipation into the current relationship)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: using a hesitant and doubtful tone, emphasizing 'maybe' 'however' 'I do not think it is needed', to weaken the necessity of trying.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether willing to share real feelings and worries with family or friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will not understand or will judge oneself(attributing one's own shame and worry to others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: avoiding direct answers, using statements like 'they will not understand' 'saying it has no meaning', then ending the topic.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When hearing others affirm their cooking or being reminded that the family likes their dishes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: treating positive information as ineffective or not counting
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: responding lightly or with negating statements, like 'that is not the same' 'those do not count', cold tone, quickly changing the topic.

manifestations: beloved cooking swallowed by Self-doubt, hard to gain the former sense of meaning from it
feeling 'the dream is slipping away' and hopelessness when thinking of professional kitchens
having friends but never discussing Self-doubt feelings, choosing to bear it alone
avoiding Cooking for others leading to less interaction with family,Relationship tension
outcomes: support system not yet effectively used
intimate Relationship estrangement and tension intensifying

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Repressing the urge to cook for others, turning to harsh self-blame and Self-doubt
not seeking help from friends or sharing feelings, choosing to bear it alone

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: believing friends will not understand one's Self-doubt, thus not sharing
assuming others will not like one's dishes

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: frequent Self-denial like 'I am not good enough'
Excessively cautious about trying change and accepting feedback; lacks confidence

positive_force: Loves cooking itself; has a foundation of sustained interest
The family likes his cooking, providing the possibility of positive feedback and support
Willing to try starting from familiar dishes and accepts an exploratory attitude of behavioral experiments
Has practice and self-study behaviors (watching tutorials, practicing new recipes)
having an available friend support network (though not yet used)
negative_force: Overgeneralization and negative prediction, focusing on negative feedback
negating positive feedback, difficulty integrating positive experiences
avoiding Cooking for others to escape judgment and sense of failure
Embarrassment and shame block seeking support from others

antecedent: When thinking about cooking for others
Imagines others' evaluations or recalls negative feedback from years ago
target_behavior.core_reason: forming the belief 'I am not good enough/will never become a great chef' after negative feedback, with strong worry about being judged (overgeneralization and negative Anticipation)
target_behavior.function: escaping judgment, shame and potential failure, temporarily relieving anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: family role affected,Strained relationships with family members, reduced cooking practice leading to further decline in skill and confidence

target_behavior.behavior: persistent automatic thoughts of Self-doubt and Self-deprecation
antecedent: Scenes before/after cooking or cooking for others
when thinking about Career development and entering professional kitchens
target_behavior.core_reason: treating a single negative feedback as evidence of stable traits, filtering and negating positive experiences, maintaining the core belief 'I am not good enough'
target_behavior.function: avoiding the risk of further attempts and possible failure by lowering expectations and Self-denial
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood,Decreased motivation,Career pursuits stalled and daily life impaired
